About Us
A warm welcome awaits you at The Carriage Houses, situated in the grounds of Beechpark House, Bunratty, in the heart of County Clare on the west coast of Ireland.
Part of the estate of a former Bishop's Palace, the Carriage Houses have been restored to provide a retreat away from the frenetic pace of the modern world. We invite you to relax in your own luxury suite, complete with all modern amenities, and succumb to a slower pace of life while you are with us.
Wherever possible, it has been our wish to showcase Irish design and product. We have selected hand made furniture from a well known family firm for your comfort and enjoyment, through to Irish crystal and crockery. The artwork, whether by contemporary Irish artists or historic prints, reflects scenes of Ireland, past and present, some of which you may recongnise as you travel through Co. Clare and beyond.
Please note, we are an adult only property.

Ryder Cup 2027 Accommodation
The Carriage Houses at Beechpark House offer an ideal accommodation option for attendees of the 46th Ryder Cup, which will take place at Adare Manor in County Limerick from the 13th to 19th September 2027.
Located just a 40-minute drive from the tournament venue, the property provides convenient access to the event while offering a very comfortable stay. Due to limited availability for these dates, interested guests are encouraged to submit their enquiries promptly using the contact details provided above.
